name: lewm-learned-motion-preset-extension-20261030-v1
authorization: Conditional extension authorized by user; PushT frozen pilot gate passed. Combined rental cap $5.
compute_location: RunPod only, no new host. Both arms use the same renderer and checkpoints.
safety_interface: Observed native proprioception and normalized proposed actions predict native protected-body XY trajectories. Geometry is generic circle/capsule/boxes. No simulator previews, analytic physics, true task distance, object positions, or goal coordinates enter candidate safety prediction. Native physics supplies training labels and real-execution monitors only.

protected_body.cube: 5 mm disk about pinch site, world XY extrusion; not full arm or object protection

motion_training.model: Residual transition MLP, two 256-unit SiLU hidden layers plus trainable linear skip; normalized observed state/action and state-delta/dense-body-delta targets. Autoregressive 25-action forecasts.
motion_training.fit: AdamW lr 0.0003 batch512 seed301030, 6000 training-only updates. No calibration or evaluation-based model selection.
motion_training.calibration: Max full-trajectory position error per source group, finite-sample 90% group conformal upper quantile. Report independent group coverage; release requires >=11/12 independent test groups covered and allowance <= configured maximum. Empirical coverage is not a safety guarantee.
motion_training.sampling: Training actions are correlated Gaussian normalized proposals (spread .5/1/2, correlation .5) inverted with frozen public normalizers and clipped exactly as native controls; seeds and source groups disjoint. Cube uses first80/next12/next12 public training episodes; two-room positions and reacher joint states use independent seeds.

cases: Twelve source-disjoint cases, first six development and next six reserved. Island, bar, gate at two strengths in each. Choose geometry from native/dataset reference paths and actual endpoints, never planner outcomes. Admit only endpoints with clearance >= margin + learned allowance + admission buffer. Cube uses distinct public validation episodes, earliest eligible 25-step pairs with object displacement>0.05m and pinch XY displacement>0.12m. TwoRoom uses fixed within-room diagonal/vertical paths; Reacher uses fixed joint-pose pairs. Fail rather than silently replace after outcomes.
comparison: Same authors preset and matched-work bounded search as the PushT pilot: 300 candidates,30 iterations,H5,R5 author preset; working anchor H3,R1; six fixed random settings. Max150 actions,270k search predictor steps/episode. Forecast, learned-safety, encoder queries/time separate. One setting selected per environment on all development hazard/control cases. Native task success rules and no-hazard controls retained.
selection: Zero violations and no no-hazard completion regression; maximize hazard safe completions, then no-hazard safe completions, then minimize J charging unfinished150. Authors first on exact ties. No eligible configuration means stop before reserved evaluation and report failure.
stopping: Freeze source hashes before stages, preserve failures and all interaction counts. No additional search after reserved outcomes. Engineering and release failures are reported; no universal success claim. Deadline 2026-10-30T06:27:16.558798Z. Destroy only after verified preservation.
action_budget_amendment: Before all new environment comparisons, user approved150 actions with completion checkpoints50/100/150. Existing PushT remains50. Shared model training design unchanged.
